gaps.criterion: API definitions authored before handlers with full producer chains
gaps.gap: The definitions were authored first — all four exist, pass projexlight_review_api_definitions with 0 missingDefinitions and no MUST findings, and carry fieldEnums for run status and template kind. The PRODUCER CHAIN half is not satisfiable as the feature stands: three of the four endpoints take a run_id, and NO LeadFlow route creates an import run. Runs are created in sdk-import through the SDK gateway, so there is nothing to {{cache:}} from and nothing to put in dependsOn beyond register/login. The id therefore comes from {{var:absent_import_run_id}} — the last-resort form MUST-36 permits when no API anywhere creates the id — and the three definitions assert the 404 branch, which is what a reachable gateway actually returns for it (verified live). This is a REAL gap and it lands on the wizard: tasks 77-80 build the Import wizard, which has to create, preview, map, dry-run and commit a run, and no task in the current plan defines a LeadFlow write surface for that. Once one exists, these three definitions should chain to it and assert the populated 200.
